Transistor Gallery

Transistor Gallery#

Every MOSFET circuit of Transistor Circuits on one sheet, for reference: 65 circuits. Each band has its idea on the left; in every column, a circuit stands above its variant. Point at a transistor or a resistor to read what it is; click to keep it marked.

# HIDE/SHOW
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

from schematic import MOSFET, gallery
from schematic import circuits as C

    ('part', 'One Transistor', 'the device, what it can be, what one sees looking into it, how much it amplifies'),

     [r'$I_D=\frac{1}{2}\mu_nC_{ox}\dfrac{W}{L}(V_{GS}-V_{TH})^2$', r'$g_m=\dfrac{2I_D}{V_{GS}-V_{TH}}$,   $r_O=\dfrac{1}{\lambda I_D}$'],
     [((C.n_type, ''), None),
      ((C.p_type, ''), None)]),
    ('Signal Roles',

      'Hold the gate: a current buffer, or a current source.'],

    ('Element Roles',

      'In triode: a resistor. Gate against channel: a capacitor.'],
     [],

      ((C.role_resistor, r'$R_\mathrm{on}=\left[\mu_nC_{ox}(W/L)(V_{GS}-V_{TH})\right]^{-1}$, triode'), (C.role_capacitor, r'$C\approx WLC_{ox}$'))]),
    ('Looking into a Terminal',

      ((C.gain_common_base, r'$A_v=\dfrac{R_D}{\dfrac{1}{g_m}+R_S}$'), (C.gain_follower, r'$A_v=\dfrac{R_S\parallel r_O}{\dfrac{1}{g_m}+R_S\parallel r_O}$'))]),
    ('part', 'Two Transistors', 'seven families; in every column the circuit, and under it its variant'),

    ('Resistors and Capacitors',

     [],

      ((C.varactor, r'$C$ tuned by $V_\mathrm{bias}$'), (C.antiparallel_capacitors, r'$C(V)$ is symmetric about zero'))]),
    ('Diodes and Level Shifts',

     [],

      ((C.level_shift, r'$V_p-V_n=V_{GS1}+V_{GS2}$'), (C.linear_i_to_v, r'$R_\mathrm{in}=\dfrac{1}{g_{m1}+g_{m2}}$, constant'))]),
    ('Switched Circuits',
     ['One device is a switch. The other is a second switch, or holds the charge.'],
     [],
     [((C.transmission_gate, r'Conducts from rail to rail'), (C.multiplexer, r'$V_\mathrm{com}=V_1$ or $V_2$')),
      ((C.sample_and_hold, r'Tracks while $M_1$ is on, holds on $M_2$'), (C.low_pass, r'$f_{-3\,\mathrm{dB}}=\dfrac{1}{2\pi R_\mathrm{on1}C_2}$')),
      ((C.peak_detector, r'$V_\mathrm{peak}=\hat V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS1}$'), (C.voltage_doubler, r'Peaks near $2\hat V_\mathrm{in}-V_{GS2}$'))]),
    ('Logic Gates',
     ['Each device is a switch driven by a logic level. In the mixer the level is a signal.'],
     [],
     [((C.nand, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\wedge V_b}$'), (C.nor, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\vee V_b}$')),
      ((C.xnor, r'$V_\mathrm{out}=\overline{V_a\oplus V_b}$'), (C.mixer, r'$I_\mathrm{out}\propto(V_\mathrm{rf}-V_{TH})\,V_{DS1}$'))]),
    ('part', 'More Transistors', 'a two-stage op amp, built one block at a time'),
    ('Two-Stage Op Amp',

     [r'$A_v=\dfrac{V_\mathrm{out}}{V_1-V_2}$'],

      ((C.op_amp_bias, r'$I_{D5}$ and $I_{D7}$ copy $I_\mathrm{ref}$ in the ratio of $W/L$'), None)]),
